# Issue #65 — Independent proactive visual QA

[Reconcile a credit purchase and return to the preserved video safely](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/65)

Reviewer: **GPT-6.1 Sol, High reasoning** (`gpt-6.1-sol`, `high`), dedicated to this issue only. Review date: **2026-10-25**, Windows, local headless Playwright Chromium, DPR 1, light appearance. Baseline and final HEAD: `9d286621177200fdb5f61ef963d0b6818ae76774`. Vite mock mode at `http://127.0.0.1:4365`, isolated contexts, muted audio and fake media flags. No physical microphone/speaker use, real payment, provider checkout, card input, paid service, product edit, spec edit, GitHub mutation, commit or push.

## Verdict and user job

**Changes are needed to the accepted mock-backed flow.** The service-backed balance and first-purchase capacity update work in the exercised simulation, and the saved source/range survives success. Pending reconciliation, history truth and the handoff back to the video do not fully satisfy the checked issue criteria. Findings: **1 HIGH, 5 MEDIUM, 0 LOW**. This review does not change issue status or prior acceptance.

The user job is to buy enough credits for a saved video section, understand the actual payment result, return to that same video, and deliberately authorize its refreshed exact processing cost. Browsing a list of packs is only one step in that job.

The current issue snapshot is [contracts/issue-65.md](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/contracts/issue-65.md), fetched by the coordinator on 2026-10-25, closed, zero discussion comments. Active authority: Flow 12 sections 3–6 and its AC; linked Flow 06 handoff; shared cancellation/failure answer; current Clean/Light adoption, reference catalog and design tokens. Existing dirty documentation, skills and historical evidence were preserved. Product source was read at the baseline; all reviewer writes are inside `issue-65/`. Old screenshots were not reused as current evidence.

## Procedure and evidence boundary

Applied Ponytail full, spec-task-review and both design skills; existing Affect UI Clean/Light and Mabry Pro override generic palette/type/density suggestions. Review only, no fixes. Semble located CreditsScreen, mock credits, header locale selection and existing visual harness before direct source reads.

Executed commands from the frontend cwd: `npm.cmd run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4365 --strictPort`. Disposable browser scripts run with Node from the repository root: `capture.cjs`, `states.cjs`, `origin.cjs`, `targeted.cjs` in this evidence directory. No full suite was run. Node REPL exited unexpectedly; standalone Playwright scripts succeeded. Two early selector failures were capture-script errors (Language is a select; the UI says Open credits), corrected before final captures. They are not product findings.

Primary journeys registered a fresh synthetic account through visible UI, read its visible local verification code and used the app's actual mock services/IndexedDB. EN/RU pack, pending, failure and verified states used visible controls. The origin journey uploaded the repository synthetic `source-dialogue.mp4` through UI and saved **0.123–8.000 seconds / 7.877 seconds**. Only its available credit state was directly seeded **120 → 2** to create a shortage. That setup is not an authoritative accounting movement; its welcome-history 120 is consequently not expected to reconcile with seeded 2. Purchase and handoff actions after setup were UI-driven. This deliberate seed is recorded in `origin-log.json`.

The late-result probe invoked the actual local mock `simulateCheckout(verified)` outside the mounted UI instance, then waited 3 seconds. This is labelled fault/late-state injection, not a provider callback. The synthetic presentation harness was used only for older-history failure and catalog failure/retry; its 2-of-6 capacity and hand-authored rows are fixture values, not product-entitlement evidence.

Every PNG listed in `screenshot-manifest.json` was opened with `view_image` and visually inspected. Captures include actual 1440×900 desktop, 1440×700 short, 390×844 phone, and EN 767/768 focus boundaries. Some phone and origin screenshots are full-page images at those CSS viewport dimensions. `metrics.json` records dimensions, overflow, controls, fonts and visible copy after `document.fonts.ready`; both Mabry Pro 400 and 500 loaded. All measured document widths equalled their viewport widths. See `source-snapshot.json` for source/spec hashes and browser details.

## Expected versus actual

| Acceptance / state | Expected | Observed in this review | Result / evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| AC-01 coherent available/reserved | Same available meaning in header/page; reservations separate | 120/0 on first visit; 140/0 after +20; origin 2/0 → 22/0. Header and page agree where both visible | Confirmed for these snapshots; no nonzero-reservation scenario executed |
| AC-02 configured mock catalog | Clearly synthetic one-time offer; no card/payment collection or invented commercial price | One 20-credit offer, 0 MOCK units, explicit no-payment/no-provider warning in EN/RU | Confirmed bounded mock presentation; commercial catalog/provider unverified |
| AC-03 start and initiation identity | Retain exact intent; reconcile duplicate/lost response safely | UI starts one local attempt; pending same pack button disabled | Partial; duplicate/lost-start/multi-tab races not re-executed |
| AC-04 pending/late success | Confirming payment, automatic safe reconciliation, no premature fulfillment | Pending keeps 120/2 slots. Mock service changes to verified but UI remains pending with no Check payment status action; reload grants 20 and changes capacity to 10 | Refuted automatic reconciliation — QA-65-01 |
| AC-04/05 unified pending history | New attempt visible without posted delta; terminal status not mislabelled | First pending screen has no pending row. After failure/reload rows appear but continue saying Pending purchase after failed/verified outcome | Refuted — QA-65-02 |
| AC-05 history older-page failure | Keep loaded rows; scoped error/retry | Synthetic EN/RU failure preserves posted and pending rows and displays Retry older activity / Повторить загрузку | Confirmed presentation only; genuine 20+ record pagination not re-executed |
| AC-06 verified origin return | Same source/range; fresh entitlement and quote; no automatic processing | Same source/range; capacity 10 and balance 22; quote missing until an extra Get exact quote click produces Process for 8 credits | Partial, QA-65-04; no processing button activated |
| AC-07 cancelled/failed origin | Safe outcome, retry, Return to video with origin | Cancelled remains Credits with 2 credits/2 slots and retry; no direct return action despite valid origin | Refuted return action — QA-65-03 |
| AC-08 / VIS EN/RU and geometry | Localized readable UI, focus, phone targets, faithful reference treatment | No overflow; 48px main phone buttons, 16px labels; visible blue focus at 767/768. Desktop purchase actions 28px/13px; phone history header and timestamps 11px | Partial; QA-65-05/06 |
| AC-VIS partial catalog errors | Valid balance/history survive failed catalog | Synthetic failure shows scoped warning/retry, then restores pack | Confirmed presentation, PNG 17/18 |

## QA-65-01 — HIGH — A known pending purchase has no automatic reconciliation path

**Class:** confirmed implementation defect plus missing service refresh instruction. **Affected:** AC-04/07, Flow 12 §4.5 and pending-verification/reconciling-return states. Evidence status: confirmed for the local mock, not a production provider claim.

**Reproduce:** start mock checkout through the primary UI. In the local mock service, simulate verified for that purchase without pressing a UI outcome button. Remain on Credits. The captured service response is `ok`, state `verified`; after 3 seconds the page still says Confirming payment, available 120, capacity 2, and exposes **zero** Check payment status buttons. Reloading that same page resolves and fulfills the purchase, showing 140 and capacity 10.

Expected automatic service-directed refresh while pending. Actual mounted UI updates only through its own simulation buttons or a reload/remount. The 3-second observation alone does not prove an infinite wait; the source establishes the missing schedule/subscription: [CreditsScreen.tsx:724](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/credits/CreditsScreen.tsx:724) loads a stored purchase on mount, while [CreditsScreen.tsx:841](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/credits/CreditsScreen.tsx:841) only exposes Check status for unknown/error cases. The purchase type has no refresh cadence/instruction ([contracts.ts:395](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/services/contracts.ts:395)). The complete Credits component contains no pending polling/subscription effect.

User impact: an externally completed result can leave the core purchase journey apparently unresolved; the user has to discover browser reload. No premature grant was observed. Recommendation: add an account/attempt-bound service refresh instruction or subscription and a readable manual reconciliation fallback while pending; keep replacement purchase blocked. Validate a delayed verified/cancelled/failed transition without user simulation clicks or reload, including leave/re-enter and cancellation cleanup.

![Late mock service result remains pending](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-65/evidence/14-en-late-verified-still-pending.png)

![Reload resolves the same verified attempt](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-65/evidence/15-en-reload-reconciles.png)

## QA-65-02 — MEDIUM — Purchase history omits the new pending attempt, then preserves obsolete pending labels

**Class:** confirmed implementation defect and incomplete attempt presentation. **Affected:** AC-04/05/08, Flow 12 §4.5–4.6.

**Reproduce:** start checkout. The pending status is visible, but history still contains only Welcome credits. Simulate failure, then start another attempt and verify it. History now shows a Verified purchase and **two Pending purchase** rows: one for the failed attempt and one for the already verified attempt. The same result occurs in RU. Reloading the late-success example retains its pending row beneath the verified charge.

Expected the authoritative pending record to appear immediately with no posted delta, then show its actual terminal state or the agreed terminal-record treatment. Actual stale pending labels contradict the terminal status above. Rows contain no pack credit/amount/currency snapshot, leaving two same-minute attempts indistinguishable. Cancelled/failed taxonomy remains an open policy choice; **continuing to claim they are pending is still misleading**. This report does not choose deletion or a commercial refund policy.

Cause: start creates a pending ledger entry ([mock-credits.ts:281](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/services/mock-credits.ts:281)), but its UI success path only loads purchase/snapshot ([CreditsScreen.tsx:616](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/credits/CreditsScreen.tsx:616)). Simulation changes only `purchases` ([mock-credits.ts:235](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/services/mock-credits.ts:235)); verified fulfillment appends another ledger entry ([mock-credits.ts:223](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/services/mock-credits.ts:223)). Rendering simply prints entry kind/time/values ([CreditsScreen.tsx:863](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/credits/CreditsScreen.tsx:863)).

User impact: uncertainty about outstanding charges and which purchase completed. Recommendation: refresh the unified feed after initiation and reconcile purchase lifecycle using stable related attempt identity; agree terminal record semantics and include the attempt's immutable mock amount/pack snapshot. Validate immediate pending visibility, failure/cancel/verified outcomes, reload, and two same-minute attempts without phantom pending labels or posted deltas.

![First pending state without the pending history row](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-65/evidence/05-en-phone-pending.png)

![Verified purchase leaves two old pending rows](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-65/evidence/08-en-desktop-verified.png)

## QA-65-03 — MEDIUM — No Return to video action after cancellation with a valid saved origin

**Class:** confirmed implementation defect. **Affected:** AC-07, Flow 12 §4.3/§5 and shared cancellation/failure owner answer.

**Reproduce:** upload/save the source, obtain the 8-credit quote with labelled seeded balance 2, choose Open credits, start mock checkout and Simulate cancellation. Expected Credits to show safe cancellation, a deliberate retry, and Return to video. Actual controls in main are only Open projects and Start mock checkout; no direct return action exists. The attempt carries the valid returnContextId (recorded in the origin journey), and the subsequent verified attempt successfully returns to the same project, establishing this was not an invalid/deleted origin.

The root is visible in the entire Credits JSX: balance only links to projects ([CreditsScreen.tsx:787](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/credits/CreditsScreen.tsx:787)); checkout actions cover simulation/status but no return action ([CreditsScreen.tsx:827](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/credits/CreditsScreen.tsx:827)). Automatic return is restricted to verified fulfillment. Header New dub is a workaround, but it does not identify the preserved video and is hidden inside navigation on phone.

User impact: purchase interruption loses the visible thread of the user's original task. No source/range loss or credit/capacity grant was observed. Recommendation: resolve the origin for pending/cancelled/failed states and show a direct Return to video action with safe invalid/expired handling. Validate all three outcomes in EN/RU desktop/phone, preserving exact source and section and requesting a fresh quote without processing.

![Cancelled origin has retry but no return action](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-65/evidence/11-en-origin-cancelled.png)

## QA-65-04 — MEDIUM — Successful return restores the video but does not request the promised fresh quote

**Class:** confirmed implementation mismatch at the Credits/New dub seam. **Affected:** AC-06, Flow 12 §3.6/§4.7; shared return contract.

**Reproduce:** from the same insufficient-credit origin, verify the second mock attempt. Actual same-tab route becomes `/new`; filename and 0.123–8.000 selection survive, balance becomes 22 and capacity 10. Processing quote says Request an exact processing quote, with Get exact quote. It does not display fresh cost/duration/balance together or the fresh Process action until another click. The next deliberate Get exact quote click produces Process for 8 credits with available 22/reserved 0.

Expected the return to request the fresh quote automatically while leaving the single deliberate Process authorization untouched. Restoration only records the active project and navigates ([CreditsScreen.tsx:413](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/credits/CreditsScreen.tsx:413)); New dub clears quote and reloads credit/source ([NewDubScreen.tsx:558](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/new-dub/NewDubScreen.tsx:558)), without invoking its quote operation on return. This is an extra quote-request step, **not** automatic processing or a stale-cost authorization defect.

Recommendation: propagate an explicit successful return intent and request a fresh service quote after the durable source/selection and entitlements load; render quote loading/error safely and leave Process unclicked. Validate exact source/revision identity, changed cost scenario, quote failure and zero processing/reservation operations until Process.

![Restored source, range and balance but no quote](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-65/evidence/12-en-success-return.png)

![Manual quote is needed to expose Process](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-65/evidence/13-en-return-manual-quote.png)

## QA-65-05 — MEDIUM — The approved compact desktop action recipe is too slight for the purchase decision

**Class:** requirement/design flaw; **not a density implementation violation or an asserted accessibility failure**. **Affected:** AC-VIS-01 quality, source button mapping, Flow 12 purchase job.

Measured desktop Start mock checkout is **28px high / 13px type / 20px line height**, about 149px wide in EN and 171px in RU. It sits at the far right of a 960px row, beside two lines of 14px explanatory text. Pending outcomes use the same small 28px/13px chips. The desktop page has ample room; the important action has less visual weight than ordinary body facts. At 768px it is still only 28px; at 767px the retained phone rule gives it 48px and 16px labels. The 24px Open projects text control is similarly small but secondary and less task-critical.

The 28px recipe follows the adopted source, so simply marking the token check PASS would miss the usability problem explicitly raised by the owner. Buying credits is an occasional, consequential decision rather than a dense toolbar operation. Recommendation for an owner decision: retain Mabry, neutral palette, source radius/shadow/focus, but establish a 36–40px / 14–16px purchase/reconciliation action tier and position it closer to the pack amount. Compare a real-size desktop prototype with keyboard/pointer users before adopting it; do not globally enlarge every compact navigation control.

Price hierarchy critique: 20 credits is 16px and the mock amount is 14px in an explanatory sentence. That is safe for the single 0-MOCK fixture, and the no-payment warning must stay conspicuous. It does **not** establish a useful multi-pack price comparison or exact-price hierarchy for approved commerce.
